projects.name: Examining the Resilience of Residential Structures Through Wildfires via Machine Learning
projects.summary: STOR 565 final group project. Used wildfire data from CALFIRE to predict the likelihood of wildfire damage to residential structures based on construction characteristics. Employed classic machine learning models including random forests, gradient boosting, and logistic regression. Utilized Python.

projects.name: Modeling Land Use Change in Wake County as a Discrete Time Markov Chain
projects.summary: PLAN 672 final project. Used parcel level data from Wake County to model land use change as a Markov Chain. Utilized R.
